Wha-ennnnn...enn...engh! Enh! Enh! Enh!''"<br />"''Oh, Artoo let him have it.''"<br />"''Mine! Mine! Mine! MINE!''"<br />"''Artoo!|Yoda and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Lamps''' were tools that were used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to illuminate dark areas. Famous examples include [[Setla lamp/Legends|setla lamps]], [[halo lamp]]s, [[Glowrod/Legends|glowlamps]], and [[sonic lamp]]s.

Inside [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Survival kit/Legends|survival kit]] was a lamp that [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] stole. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] struggled to retrieve the item, but Yoda hit R2-D2 with his cane repeatedly until Luke told R2 to let Yoda have the lamp.
